domain: non-fundamentals price/volume - EODHD daily OHLCV only, name-level; no SEC fundamentals fields anywhere (A6 wave-diversity axis); mutually distinct from SFV8-A6-NF-01 (volume-free intraday geometry vs volume-weighted sign composition)
title: Close-range position pressure reversal: chronic bottom-of-daily-range closes as paid close-auction supply

mechanism_question.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: Market-on-close participants - index trackers, NAV-marking mutual funds, and close-benchmarked executions - concentrate one-sided order flow into the final auction of the session; they are execution-forced (they must transact at the close regardless of price). The patient counterparties (intraday suppliers who inventory overnight) are slow to react and adjust positions over weeks.
mechanism_question.why_the_effect_exists: When a name's sessions persistently close in the BOTTOM of its same-day high-low range, the marginal close-time flow is execution-forced selling that suppliers absorb at a discount; the inventory risk of holding into the next open is compensated (Grossman-Miller 1988; Nagel 2012), and close-time trading has documented return-predictive pressure (Cushing-Madhavan 2000). Chronic bottom-of-range closes therefore mark an execution-timing discount that clears as subsequent outperformance; chronic top-of-range closes mark bought-at-the-close pressure and subsequent underperformance. Infrequent rebalancing makes the pressure persist predictably across sessions (Bogousslavsky 2016), and the overnight/intraday clientele split is exactly where execution timing prices differently (Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019).
mechanism_question.what_observable_measures_it: CLV(i,t) = ((C_t - L_t) - (H_t - C_t)) / (H_t - L_t) in {-1,+1} on days with H_t > L_t (limit/one-print days excluded from that day's mean, exclusion count reported); signal = equal-weighted mean of CLV over the trailing 63 sessions. Pure intraday high-low geometry of the session close: no volume term, no return over any window, no variance term. Sort: long lowest mean-CLV tercile (chronic bottom-of-range closes), short highest.
mechanism_question.when_it_must_fail: (a) when close prints are information-motivated (informed closing flow does not revert); (b) when the geometry degenerates into a volatility proxy - the Parkinson range-width control would then reproduce the anchor and the family is dead; (c) when the pressure premium is smaller than the band-cost drag; (d) when close-auction mechanics change so that the close no longer concentrates forced flow (the effect is a market-structure artifact by construction and inherits its fragility).
mechanism_question.what_control_kills_convenient_explanatio: The range-width (vol-level-proxy) control kills the convenient explanation 'you are just short high-vol / long low-vol names'; the open-location neighbour separates close-auction pressure from overnight-gap clientele; drop-one-symbol and fold-removal kill concentration and single-regime artifacts; the band-aware stress rerun kills the cost-subsidy explanation.

falsifiable_prediction: Long-low minus short-high mean-CLV tercile book (gross 1.0, net ~0, ~130 names per leg at ~390-408 eligible names per decision per p2) has positive expectancy AFTER band-aware base costs, position PF >= 1.1, >= 2 of 3 folds positive, risk-matched incremental alpha > 0 overall and in >= 2 folds; the range-width control's absolute alpha is < 0.5 x anchor alpha. Family is falsified if the anchor is non-positive after base costs, if the range-width control reproduces or outruns the anchor (geometry is a vol mask - the V4 level-axis lesson applied ex ante), or if the open-location neighbour matches the anchor exactly (story reduces to overnight-gap clientele, not close pressure).

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti: Sole inputs are EODHD daily RAW OHLCV (H, L, C) from the sha256-pinned staged files; adjusted series only as authorized cross-check. Observables: CLV(i,t) from same-session H/L/C; OLV(i,t) = ((O_t - L_t) - (H_t - O_t)) / (H_t - L_t) for the neighbour; RW(i,t) = (H_t - L_t) / C_t for the control; means over trailing 63 sessions; ADV63 per P3. Availability semantics: every bar is readable at session close + 1 session (P3 v8_additions), so a decision at session d uses bars through session d-1 and never the decision session's own bar. Rebalance clock stated explicitly: decisions every 21st S0 session indexed from each fold's first eligible decision, session-index-anchored and calendar-blind. The 154-clock citation rule is vacuous: no PIT conditioning, no clock cited.

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.eligibility: per P3 floor at each decision: frozen 410-panel filer; servable at that decision (p2_coverage_first.json per-name facts); ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better); RAW price >= 1.00. p2 band populations: start A=286/B=94/C=10, mid A=307/B=87/C=11, end A=376/B=31/C=1.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup: 63 servable sessions before the first decision in each fold.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.rebalance_clock: every 21st S0 session from the fold's first decision; no calendar anchoring.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding: 21 sessions to the next decision; force flat at fold boundaries; gross 1.0 (0.5/0.5), net ~0, CASH absorbs residual.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.fills: decision on bars through d-1; fills next allowed session after the decision, close-to-close per V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill.

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: 63-day mean-CLV rank book: long bottom tercile (chronic bottom-of-range closes), short top tercile, equal-weight legs, +/-1-decile hysteresis.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour_mechanism: 63-day mean-OLV (open-location value): same high-low geometry anchored at the OPEN, which is set by overnight news rather than close-auction flow. Intended L7 profile: moderate positive Spearman with anchor ranks, weaker expectancy - partial support for a session-time pressure reading. If OLV fully reproduces the anchor, the mechanism is overnight-gap clientele (Lou-Polk-Skouras territory) rather than close-auction pressure and the family is downweighted/flagged for adjudication.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.causal_negative_control: 63-day Parkinson-style range-width percentile, mean of (H-L)/C: a volatility-LEVEL proxy built from the same H/L/C columns. Intended profile: |Spearman(anchor, control)| < 0.25 - rank-distinct because a name can have wide daily ranges with closes pinned mid-range (anchor ~0, control high) and narrow ranges that close at the extremes (anchor extreme, control low). The control must NOT reproduce: gate |control alpha| < 0.5 x |anchor alpha|. If it reproduces or outruns the anchor, the geometry is a volatility mask - the level axis, not the pressure axis - and the family is falsified per the frozen causal_control_rule, directly encoding the V4 lesson before any scoring.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.secondary_placebo: range-pairing shuffle: pair each close with a randomly chosen (fixed ex-ante seed) other session's H/L within the same name-window, preserving range-width distribution while destroying close-to-range alignment; the anchor must beat the shuffled-geometry book.

incremental_alpha_test: Per the frozen factor contract: arm minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule), per fold and overall; gate: overall > 0, >= 2 folds positive. Second benchmark: equal-weight sector ETF total return (authorized optional sector factor); report arm-minus-sector per fold. After-cost booked PnL only; raw PnL or beta never accepted as alpha.
base_and_stress_costs: P3 liquidity-band model on booked PnL, charged once per side per fill, linear, no sidecar. Base: A 10 / B 15 / C 25 bps per side; stress 2x: A 20 / B 30 / C 50. Bands assigned per ADV63 at each decision. At expected annualized two-way turnover ~4.5-6.5 raw (ceiling-normalized 6.0 reported), base drag ~45-165 bps/yr given the p2 band mix (book dominated by A/B), stress ~90-330 bps/yr. Both base and stress reruns declared.
turnover_and_sample_floor: 21-session cadence over 1,837 S0 sessions: ~86 decision periods total (>= 30 required) and ~28/29/29 per fold (>= 5 required). Hysteresis holds raw two-way turnover near the 6.0 ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized both reported (sum |delta w| over non-CASH legs).
drop_one_design: (1) value_book rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0. (2) per-fold removal; survival iff min over folds > 0. (3) anchor-extreme robustness: rerun excluding each decision's single most-negative mean-CLV name. Identical eligibility, band costs and fill clock in all reruns.

failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_controls_negative: close-range pressure is not compensated in this panel of institutional-quality filers; report margin-to-fail.
failure_interpretation.range_width_control_reproduces: volatility mask, not close-pressure geometry - family falsified ex ante, no rescue (this is the preregistered L7 kill).
failure_interpretation.OLV_neighbour_matches_anchor: overnight-gap clientele, not close-auction pressure; mechanism reattributed and downweighted.
failure_interpretation.only_fold_2_positive: 2020 market-structure dislocation artifact (close-auction regime stress), not a persistent mechanism.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_raw_negative_after_costs: pressure premium exists but does not clear its own liquidity cost.
failure_interpretation.all_gates_pass: proceeds confirmatory with preregistered parameters only; no post-hoc re-tuning.
